title: Under the Whispering Door
author: TJ Klune
summary: A ruthless lawyer dies and wakes up in a small tea shop at the edge of the afterlife, run by a ferryman who helps the dead cross over. He is given time to reckon with the person he was, and slowly starts to care about the people there.
readIf: you want a funny, warm book about death, grief and second chances.
skipIf: you find stories centred on mourning too hard, or dislike sentimental, speech-heavy writing.

pairings.reason: Same author, another comforting story about a lonely man and a household that welcomes him.
Another story where a stranded person is shown what a life is worth by getting a second look.
A grumpy man softened by those who refuse to leave him alone, told without fantasy.
